assessment_objective: AO3 solve problems (translate, connect content areas, interpret); AO2 interpret and communicate
problem_types: Paint a wall minus a door then whole tins and cost; tile an L-shaped floor with cm tiles in boxes; gravel a path round a pond; fill a tank at a rate; whole glasses from a cylinder; Higher: capacity of similar containers
stage_traps: area only; unrounded tins/boxes/bags; door or corner not removed; cm/m and cm³/litre not converted; rounding the wrong way; scale factor not cubed
gap: Only the final answer is marked; written method and method marks not assessed

assessment_objective: AO3 solve problems; AO2 reason with percentages
problem_types: Share in a ratio then spend a percentage of the share; best buy with percentage off against buy-3-pay-for-2; price before 20% VAT; pay with overtime; simple against compound interest; Higher: years until a depreciating value falls below a target
stage_traps: share only; percentage of the total instead of the share; wrong share; percentage off read as paying the percentage; offer misread; × 0.8 to reverse VAT; overtime at the normal rate or for all hours; compound treated as simple; straight-line depreciation; one year short
gap: Only the final answer is marked

assessment_objective: AO3 model situations with equations; AO2 interpret solutions in context
problem_types: Angles of a triangle and a quadrilateral as expressions; rectangle sides as expressions with a given perimeter then area; ages in words; ticket prices by simultaneous equations; Higher: rectangle area as a quadratic, then perimeter
stage_traps: x given instead of the asked quantity; smaller angle; 180 used for a quadrilateral; half perimeter; sign of a side; another person's age; one price instead of the combination; negative root not rejected (width only)
gap: The equation formed is not marked

assessment_objective: AO3 solve problems; AO2 interpret statistics and probability
problem_types: Combined mean of two groups; value of a new member from a change in mean; missing frequency from a given mean; expected profit of a game; counters from a probability and a ratio; expected number from two events
stage_traps: mean of means; total not divided; new mean given; frequency confused with mean; expected wins or takings or prizes only; ratio applied before removing green; one branch only; probabilities added along a branch
gap: Trees are modelled in steps, not drawn by the student
